panels.title: End-to-end latency per packet (frame 0 inject -> DB ack)

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ehg_pkt" and r.node_id =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
 |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value")
 |> filter(fn: (r) => not r.retrans)
 |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, node_id: r.node_id, _value: r.t_db_ack - r.t_inject_host}))
 |> group(columns:["node_id"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ehg_pkt" and r.node_id =~ /^${node:regex}$/ and r._field == "seq")
 |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
 |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 10.0}))

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ehg_pkt" and r.node_id =~ /^${node:regex}$/ and r._field == "retrans")
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == true)
 |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
